cd /workspace && python3 -m poetry run python dcat_catalog_check.py --url http://localhost:8000/catalog.ttl --results /tmp/results.jsonl --recheck > /tmp/recheck.jsonl 2>/tmp/recheck.stderr.log; echo "EXIT: $?"; wc -l /tmp/recheck.jsonl; python3 -c "
import json
lines=[json.loads(l) for l in open('/tmp/recheck.jsonl') if l.strip()]
print('recheck results:', len(lines), '| good:', sum(1 for l in lines if l.get('num_good_checks',0)>=1))
print('RECHECK OK')"
